title: Runner 2 · Portfolio State Machine v2 (rebuild from screener → stateful portfolio manager)
hypothesis: Runner 2 currently behaves as a Top-N daily screener (score → sort → print top 3). Rebuilding it as a stateful portfolio manager with persistent positions, explicit lifecycle events, rotation hysteresis, and single-horizon discipline will eliminate the 10 architectural inconsistencies observed on 2026-07-31 (LUPIN vanished without exit event · 11 sources → 1 destination churn · mixed 17d + 90d horizons · day 2 of 90 for a stock recommended today).

evidence.predecessor_ticket: R002_runner2_ensemble_v3.json (score → sort · needs to be extended, not replaced)

decisions.note: Opened 2026-07-31 after operator identified 10 architectural issues from live Telegram outputs. This ticket spans BOTH markets (India + USA) because Runner 2 is the same engine on both. Full specification below in `issues_addressed` and `redesign_plan` fields.

1_rotation_engine_unstable.observed: Day 1: rotate BATAINDIA → LUPIN · Day 2: rotate BIOCON → TCS · 11 different stocks all rotating to a single destination
1_rotation_engine_unstable.root_cause: Daily rescoring without persistence · pure Top-N replacement · no hysteresis
1_rotation_engine_unstable.fix: Rotation requires meaningful alpha edge threshold (e.g. new candidate must beat current holding by >= 5pp expected alpha AND persist for 3 consecutive days before rotation triggers)

2_holding_period_broken.observed: Yesterday LUPIN hold 17d · Today LUPIN vanished · TCS appeared with hold 90d
2_holding_period_broken.root_cause: No portfolio memory · every day starts fresh · positions silently dropped
2_holding_period_broken.fix: Once a position is opened at horizon N days, that horizon is LOCKED for the position's lifetime · never mixed with other horizons in same runner

3_entry_lifecycle_broken.observed: TCS shows 'day 2 of 90' today but yesterday TCS wasn't recommended at all
3_entry_lifecycle_broken.root_cause: days_recommended derived from ANY prior appearance in position_store · not from actual portfolio entry event
3_entry_lifecycle_broken.fix: days_recommended = (today - portfolio.entered_on) where entered_on is the first BUY event in the portfolio ledger · not just any position_store touch

4_positions_vanish_silently.observed: Yesterday LUPIN · HEROMOTOCO · CHAMBLFERT recommended · today gone · no exit event · no stop · no target hit · no expiry · no reason
4_positions_vanish_silently.root_cause: Runner 2 has no exit lifecycle · dropped picks disappear from recs.json
4_positions_vanish_silently.fix: Every position MUST end with exactly one terminal event: EXIT · STOP · TARGET · HORIZON_EXPIRED · MANUAL_ROTATION. Rendered explicitly in Telegram Exits block.

5_runner2_is_top_n_screener.observed: Behavior = universe → score → sort → top 3 → print
5_runner2_is_top_n_screener.correct_behavior: universe → score → CHECK EXISTING PORTFOLIO → decide HOLD/ROTATE/ADD/EXIT per position → only THEN add new capital
5_runner2_is_top_n_screener.fix: Insert portfolio state machine between score-engine and output · see redesign_plan.pipeline_shape

6_rotation_source_inconsistent.observed: Yesterday BATA/AMBER/JSW → LUPIN · Today BIOCON/FORTIS/GRASIM → TCS · Where did yesterday's rotations go? Executed? Ignored? Expired?
6_rotation_source_inconsistent.fix: Rotation ledger: reports/research/rotation_ledger.jsonl · every proposed rotation logged with outcome (EXECUTED · REJECTED_BY_HYSTERESIS · CANCELLED · EXPIRED)

7_canonical_portfolio_not_respected.observed: Runner 1 says 11 active picks · but no Runner 1 EXITS shown · so CEO cannot know keep vs sell vs replace
7_canonical_portfolio_not_respected.fix: Every runner (R1 and R2) must emit full state distribution: BUY · HOLD · REDUCE · SELL · ROTATE per position · not just actionable subset

8_mixed_holding_horizons.observed: Same portfolio shows 17-day picks AND 90-day picks in same day
8_mixed_holding_horizons.risk: Contradictory signals · unclear whether runner is swing or position
8_mixed_holding_horizons.fix: Single investment horizon per runner · Runner 2 config declares its horizon (e.g. 17d or 90d) · never mixed

9_rotation_destination_explosion.root_cause: Ranking engine picks single highest score every day · no diversification
9_rotation_destination_explosion.fix: Portfolio optimizer with: top-20 candidates → sector constraints → correlation filter → diversification target → max N rotations per day (e.g. 2)

10_portfolio_memory_missing.observed: Engine behaves as if every day starts from zero · re-recommends same tickers · doesn't check existing holdings
10_portfolio_memory_missing.fix: Load current portfolio state at start of every daily run · every recommendation must consider what's already held

pipeline_shape: Load Current Portfolio (new · from position ledger)
Portfolio State Machine (new): HOLD | ADD | ROTATE | EXIT | PARTIAL_EXIT | REBALANCE
Portfolio Optimizer (new): sector caps · correlation · diversification · max-N-rotations
position_lifecycle_states: NEW      · first appearance in portfolio ledger
ACTIVE   · currently held · within horizon · not yet hit stop/target
HOLD     · still valid · continue holding · explicit HOLD event (not silent removal)
EXITED   · terminal · with recorded reason (EXIT | STOP | TARGET | HORIZON_EXPIRED | MANUAL_ROTATION)

rotation_hysteresis.rationale: Prevent daily churn · require meaningful and stable edge before replacing an existing position

horizon_lock.rule: Each runner has ONE horizon · position takes on its runner's horizon at open · never mutates

portfolio_state_at_open_of_daily_run.shape: {ticker: {opened_on, entry_price, current_state, horizon_days, allocated_pct, target_price, stop_price, high_water}}

acceptance_criteria: No position vanishes without an explicit exit event visible in Telegram
Rotation churn drops to <= 2 per day per market
Every recommendation shows accurate 'day X of Y' matching portfolio ledger (not last-seen-in-recs)
Runner 2 shows full BUY/HOLD/REDUCE/SELL distribution · not just actionables
Single horizon per runner · no mixed 17d + 90d in same output
Max Gain / Max DD populate from position store's high/low updated daily (not entry-price defaults)
Rotation ledger appended · every proposed rotation traceable to outcome
Backtest 30 days of paper trading shows portfolio drift < 3x rotation churn threshold
explicitly_out_of_scope: Runner 3 · not building a third engine on top of a broken Runner 2
Changes to Runner 1 · adaptive_rec_v2 stays SEALED · out of Article III polish
Changes to intraday · R004 tracked separately
